title: PHASE A3 (THE HEADLINE GATE, gated_on A2 selector_trained) -- does the ORACLE-DISTINCT learned ARC verifier BEAT majority vote OFF-ORACLE? On a HELD-OUT ARC candidate pool, rerank with the A2 learned verifier (verifier_is_oracle=false; does NOT execute the demos) vs majority-vote vs a MATCHED no-verifier control (same candidates/budget) vs oracle@K (the positive-control ceiling). The LOAD-BEARING gate: verifier@1 - vote@1, bootstrap CI95 EXCLUDES 0 AND headroom exists (oracle@K >> vote). Framed by ARBITER (arXiv:2605.26172) 'wrong-majority failures' -- the correct answer is in the pool but loses to a bigger wrong basin; the oracle-distinct verifier's job is to recover it. YES -> the first oracle-distinct verifier win (closes GAP-3-ties-vote; informs the DiffusionGemma gate). TIE-with-headroom -> honest null (GAP-3 frontier persists). No-headroom -> uninformative.
